item.title: French soldier killed by Iranian drone was on anti-jihad mission in Iraq
item.summary: The French officer killed by an Iranian-made drone on Thursday was part of a Western military contingent working to combat potential jihadists in Iraqi Kurdistan. The killing of Chief Warrant Officer Arnaud Frion marks France's first military death in the Middle East war.

item.title: Residents refuse to leave the Lebanese Hezbollah bastion of Tyre despite Israeli strikes
item.summary: As Israel has ramped up attacks on south Lebanon it has called for residents to evacuate – but some in the Hezbollah stronghold of Tyre are refusing to leave their homes and businesses despite the danger.
